about.seoDescription: A volunteer-led tech initiative committed to creating #civictech projects aimed at making government more transparent, efficient, and accessible to citizens.
about.goal: Our goal is to support, promote, consolidate, and empower citizen builders!
about.provideIntro: To support citizen builders in building impactful civic tech projects:
about.angry: We're angry. You're angry. But we can contribute in our own ways — no matter how little it is.
about.together: We can do amazing things together. Grassroots style. Open source. No permission needed.
about.committed: We are committed to putting time, resources, and money into this initiative. We will keep building relentlessly without anyone's permission. Open source, public, high quality sites.
about.ctaBody: Join our community of builders, dreamers, and changemakers.

volunteer.question: How can I volunteer for BetterGov?
volunteer.answer: We welcome volunteers with various skills! Check out our Join Us page to see current opportunities and fill out our volunteer form.

affiliation.question: Is BetterGov affiliated with the Philippine government?
affiliation.answer: No, BetterGov is an independent volunteer-led initiative. We work alongside government agencies but are not officially part of the Philippine government.

bugs.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
bugs.answer: The best way is to open an issue on our GitHub repository. This helps us track and prioritize all requests.

reuse.question: Can I use BetterGov content for my project?
reuse.answer: Yes! BetterGov is released under Creative Commons CC0, meaning our content is in the public domain and can be used freely for any purpose.

data.question: Where does the data on BetterGov come from?
data.answer: Our data is aggregated from various publicly available government sources. We use custom scripts and tools to collect, process, and display this information in a way that is easy for citizens to access and understand.

ideas.seoDescription: Explore innovative project ideas to improve government transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement.
ideas.title: Project Ideas
ideas.intro: Innovative concepts to enhance government transparency, accountability, and citizen engagement. These ideas aim to bridge the gap between citizens and government through technology and better design.

1.title: Blockchain powered community government project reporting app
1.description: A transparent, immutable platform where citizens can report and track government projects in their communities. Uses blockchain technology to ensure data integrity and prevent tampering with project reports and progress updates.

2.title: Glassdoor for government agencies
2.description: An anonymous review platform where government employees and citizens can rate and review government agencies, departments, and services. Provides insights into workplace culture, service quality, and areas for improvement.

3.title: Design guidelines for {{portal}}
3.description: Comprehensive design system and guidelines for the {{portal}} platform. Includes UI components, color schemes, typography, accessibility standards, and best practices for government web services.

4.title: Rate the politicians
4.description: A citizen-driven platform to rate and review elected officials based on their performance, campaign promises, voting records, and public service delivery. Includes fact-checking and transparency features.

ideas.ctaBody: We're always looking for innovative ways to improve government services and citizen engagement. Submit your ideas via GitHub or learn more about our mission.

contribute.title: Contribute to {{portal}}
contribute.description: Help us keep the service directory accurate and up-to-date.
steps: Click the button below to open a contribution form on GitHub. You'll need a free GitHub account.

contribute.whyGithub: Why GitHub? Using GitHub ensures all contributions are attributed to real accounts, helps prevent spam, and lets us track the review process transparently.
whatList: New services not yet in the directory

weather.unavailableTitle: Weather is not available right now
weather.unavailableMessage: Current conditions for {{lgu}} will appear here once the weather service is connected.
weather.aboutBody: The weather shown on this page comes from OpenWeatherMap, a commercial weather service, and is refreshed about once an hour. It is not an official PAGASA forecast.
weather.understandingBody: Temperature is displayed in Celsius (°C). Weather conditions are categorized based on current atmospheric observations. The forecast provides a 5-day outlook to help you plan ahead.
weather.advisoriesBody: For official weather advisories, warnings, and detailed forecasts, please visit the <anchor>PAGASA official website</anchor> or follow their social media channels for real-time updates.

forex.providedBy: Exchange rates are provided by Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). Last updated: {{date}}
forex.aboutBody: The foreign exchange rates displayed on this page are sourced from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), the central bank of the Philippines. These rates represent the official reference rates for the Philippine Peso against major world currencies.
forex.understandingBody: Exchange rates indicate how much of one currency can be exchanged for another. The rates shown here represent the amount of Philippine Pesos (PHP) needed to purchase one unit of the foreign currency.
forex.officialBody: For official foreign exchange reference rates and more detailed information, please visit the <anchor>Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas website</anchor>.

accessibility.seoDescription: Our commitment to web accessibility, current progress toward WCAG, features we support today, and how to request help.
accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: {{portal}} is committed to making {{adjectiveLower}} information usable for people with disabilities. We improve the experience continuously and do not claim full certification.
commitment: Everyone should be able to reach local government information and services. We design for assistive technologies such as screen readers and keyboard navigation, and we treat accessibility bugs as first-class defects.
This portal is volunteer-run. Features and audits improve over time; if something blocks you, tell us and we will prioritize a fix or provide an alternative.

visual.title: Visual Accessibility
items: Kapwa design tokens for text and surface contrast
Text that scales with browser zoom
Alt text on meaningful images where present
Clear page headings and section structure
Works with common screen readers (ongoing testing)

keyboard.title: Keyboard Navigation
items: Core navigation and links are keyboard reachable
Visible focus styles on interactive controls
Skip link to jump past the header into main content
Logical reading and tab order on primary pages
Escape closes search overlays and menus where implemented

audio.title: Audio & Screen Reader Support
items: Semantic landmarks (header, main, footer)
Heading hierarchy on key pages
Descriptive link text in most navigation
Labeled form fields and search inputs
Status updates for hero search results

motor.title: Motor Accessibility
items: Comfortable hit targets on primary buttons and nav items
Pointer and keyboard alternatives for common actions
No essential drag-and-drop on public pages
Clear error states on forms we ship
Multiple paths to services (search, categories, directory)

mobile.title: Mobile Accessibility
items: Responsive layout across phone, tablet, and desktop
Touch-friendly spacing on primary controls
Browser zoom supported
Works in portrait and landscape
Standard mobile browser input methods

language.title: Language & Cognitive Support
items: Plain-language service names where available
Consistent navigation patterns
English and Filipino interface strings
Content grouped with clear headings
Contact path for questions and feedback

standards.wcag: We aim for WCAG 2.1 Level AA. This site is not yet fully audited or certified; we fix gaps as we find them.
standards.section508: We follow Section 508 principles where they apply to a civic volunteer portal. Full conformance is not claimed.
standards.en301549: We have not evaluated against EN 301 549. European standards are a longer-term reference, not a current claim.

keys.noShortcut: There is no global Ctrl+K shortcut yet. Use the hero or site search fields, or open Search from the navigation.

accessibility.feedbackBody: If you hit an accessibility barrier on {{portal}}, email us. Include the page URL, what you tried, and the assistive technology you use if you can.
accessibility.lastUpdated: This accessibility statement was last updated on <time>July 27, 2026</time>.
accessibility.revise: We revise it when supported features or known gaps change.
